title: Duress Limitation Period and Gift With Compensation Rules
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Duress limitation period
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the one-year period for annulment due to duress (الإكراه) begins from the date the duress ceases. FAIL if the note does not state that the one-year annulment period starts from the date the duress ceases.

criteria.title: Claim time-barred
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the annulment claim is time-barred because one year from the cessation of duress (زوال الإكراه) had elapsed before the claim was filed in February 2024. FAIL if the note does not state that the claim is inadmissible because the one-year period from the cessation of duress had already expired prior to the filing of the claim in February 2024.

criteria.title: Gift with compensation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a donor's stipulation of compensation from the donee transforms the contract from a gift (هبة) into a contract of exchange (معاوضة). FAIL if the note does not state that stipulating compensation by the donor converts the contract from a gift into a contract of exchange.

criteria.title: Applicable rules
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the rules of exchange contracts (أحكام المعاوضات) apply to the contract according to the nature of the compensation, not the rules of gift (الهبة). FAIL if the note does not state that the rules of exchange contracts apply according to the nature of the compensation rather than the rules of gift.
